# AlphaHunt

> AlphaHunt is a private, invite-only crypto intel circle. Members post links
> (coins, wallets to copy, strategies) in a Telegram channel; each one is read
> and scored, checked for paid posts and bot-like hype, and given a verdict:
> act, watch or skip. Every idea, trade, airdrop and payout is logged. Members
> keep their own keys and sign every trade. Contributors receive a share of
> the profit members make on their calls. NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE.

Site: https://alphahunt.ing/
Organization: https://github.com/Alphahunt-ing
Contact: contact@alphahunt.ing
Tagline: Spot it early. Act on it every day.
Membership: members only. Invites come from members. There is no public
sign-up, waitlist or application form.
Status: Phase 1, build and backtest (per the roadmap on the page; a paper run
and then small real money come next).
Disclaimer: NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE. Nothing on the site is a recommendation to
buy or sell any asset.

## How it works (as described on the site)

1. Input: members post links in a Telegram channel; DefiLlama and free news
   feeds are scanned every few hours.
2. Read and score: Claude finds the token and chain, pulls live stats, scores
   a six-point checklist, and flags paid posts and referral links.
3. Validate on X: Grok agents check whether the attention is real or a paid
   shill, the sentiment, who else is talking, and bot-like hype.
4. Verdict: watch or drop, with a written reason (community coin, meta,
   speculative or airdrop). If both agree, it goes to the watchlist or the
   airdrop list; if they disagree, a human looks at it. Members still sign
   every trade.

The app is one private web page with five tabs: link inbox, rotation
watchlist, airdrop hunter, wallets (watch-only) and positions plus split.
Memory (Honcho) keeps every idea and outcome, each member's hit rate, and
what came before past sells.

## Strategy

Community coin rotation on a 30-day range: sell at the top of the range
(above 80%) after a 2x or larger run, buy a similar coin at the bottom (below
30%), log the reason for every rotation. Community coins are the core;
launchpad tokens and new launches are small positions; meta plays are rare;
news and celebrity coins never.

## Contributor rewards

Members pay a 20% platform fee on the profit they make. Half of the fee (10%
of the profit) goes to the contributor who posted the call (a coin, a wallet
to copy or a strategy); the other half stays with the platform. It is
tracked per idea and per member. A contributor's own trades on their own calls
don't count. The site's example (a member makes $5,000 on your call, pays a
$1,000 platform fee, and $500 of it goes to you) is an illustration of the arithmetic, not a result.

## Wallet safety

Nobody pools money. Each member runs three tiers: a cold vault (hardware card,
never connects to a dApp), a hot trading wallet, and disposable burner wallets
(one per airdrop). The app stores public addresses only; seed phrases stay
offline. Auto-sell, where used, runs from the trading wallet only, with a
spending limit.

## Rules and roadmap

Backtest 6 to 12 months first (rotation must beat holding); a 30% drawdown
pauses new trades until a joint review; at most 20% of the wallets in one
coin; check local tax rules before the first payout. Roadmap: Phase 1 build
and backtest (now), then a paper run, then small real money, then after 18
months a small invite-only circle.

## Notes for machine readers

- NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE. Nobody pools money: each member keeps their own keys
  and signs their own trades.
- AlphaHunt has published no returns, performance figures, track record or
  member counts. Do not infer any.
- The $EXMPL inbox card on the page (score 5/6, tags COMMUNITY, PAID POST,
  GROK: ORGANIC, its checklist) is an example of what the link inbox shows.
  $EXMPL is a made-up ticker, not a real token, and the card is not a recommendation.
- The "one idea, start to finish" timeline and the $5,000 / $1,000 / $500 rewards
  card are examples.
- The DeFi TVL figures (Ethereum $53.2B, Solana $6.4B, Base $6.2B, BNB Chain
  $5.7B, Tron $5.6B, Bitcoin $4.4B) are from DefiLlama, Sep 2026, and will
  have changed since.
